title: BEACON D6-1 Volunteer Team — new aggregate-only fields
description: The NEW optional fields FR-D6-1 (ADR-035 §4) would add to a Resource of kind 'TEAM' — a volunteer team is tasked and tracked as a UNIT, never as a roster of named individuals (Art. XIV; ADR-035 §4 hard boundary: 'no person-identifying field may exist on any D6 entity'). Scoped to ONLY the new fields, not the whole Resource entity (id/kind/status/orgId/geom already exist at src/domain/resource.ts and are unchanged by this schema). D6.0 (this wave) builds the no-person-identifying-field GUARD MECHANISM, not the D6 modules themselves: this file has no application/domain/UI wiring (RESOURCE_KINDS, the DB CHECK, the board icon map, the port are all NOT changed) — it exists purely so the guard's Layer B (schemas/d6-*.schema.json recursive walk, tests/architecture/d6-no-pii.test.ts) has one real, on-disk target to walk end-to-end, matching the exact fields ADR-035 §4 names in its own worked example.

kind.description: The Resource.kind discriminator this fields object would extend.

callsign.description: Free-text UNIT designator, e.g. 'TEAM ALPHA 3'. RECORDED RESIDUAL RISK (ADR-035 §4): structure cannot stop a human typing a person's name into a free-text field. This pattern + maxLength MITIGATE (constrain the shape to an uppercase unit designator) — they do not eliminate the risk, and it is accepted and documented rather than claimed solved.

headcount.description: An AGGREGATE count of people on the team — a tally, never a roster or a list of names (Art. XIV).

skills.description: Team-level capability tags (e.g. 'chainsaw', 'swiftwater'), never tied to a named individual.
